text: dsh-better-edit 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 编程代理的文件读取与编辑插件。它在每个 agent 创建时注册哈希锚点 read、edit、undo_last_edit 和兼容式 str_replace_editor 工具，以三字符行锚点定位内容，并提供原子多处编辑、冲突校验、编辑后差异和持久撤销。它适合希望减少代码回显、避免行号漂移并可靠修改工作区文件的开发代理；无需额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-better-edit adds hash-anchored read, edit, and undo tools to DeepSeek Harness agents. Three-character anchors support atomic edits, conflict checks, fresh diffs, and persistent undo, helping agents change files without line-number drift. No API key or external service is required.
想让代码代理按内容定位行，修改文件时不再依赖容易变化的行号。
有没有办法只提交要替换的片段，不必把大段未改代码重新发给编辑工具？
我希望一次调用就能原子地修改同一个文件里的多个位置。
文件被格式化或前面的内容插入后，怎样避免编辑落到错误的行？
能不能在编辑后直接看到带新锚点的差异，继续编辑时少读一次文件？
刚才那次文件修改弄错了，我想把文件恢复到编辑前的内容。
我需要让多个编码代理的读取状态互相隔离，避免一个会话的锚点被另一个会话误用。
希望代码助手能读取大文件的指定页，或者一次读取几个不连续的范围。
I want a coding agent to edit file ranges by stable content anchors instead of shifting line numbers.
Can an edit tool change several independent ranges in one atomic call without repeating surrounding source code?
I need to undo the most recent file edit and restore its original text and line endings.
How can an agent read selected windows of a large text file and use those rows as edit anchors?
哈希锚点读取：read 按页或多个行窗口读取文本文件，并为返回的每一行附加三字符锚点，供后续编辑引用。
锚点范围编辑：edit 接收起止锚点和替换文本，可在单次调用中原子修改同一文件的多个范围，并返回编辑结果。
撤销最近编辑：undo_last_edit 检查文件仍符合该次编辑结果后，恢复先前内容、BOM 与换行格式；撤销状态可持久保存。
兼容编辑器工具：str_replace_editor 提供 view、str_replace、insert 与 create 操作，并由插件的文件访问适配层执行。
使用前须知：插件会在本机配置目录维护哈希快照与撤销状态数据库；存储目录可通过配置或环境变量调整。

dsh-better-edit README · Introduction：> **What is `dsh-better-edit`?**
> A high-precision file editing plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) that replaces volatile line numbers and token-wasting code echoes with immutable, content-addressed 3-character line hashes (`szJ│code`).
>
> **Core Philosophy:** Local compute is free; **the model's context window is the most precious resource**. By shifting verification, snapshotting, and alignment to the host, `dsh-better-edit` slashes output tokens by 40–60%, auto-rebases external file drift (e.g., Prettier, Git), and eliminates silent miswrites without forcing full-file re-reads.

text:
dsh-better-edit README · 1. 🪙 Token Economics (40–60% Context Savings)：- **$O(R)$ Edit Payloads**: The model emits only `{ "path": "...", "edits": [["a1b", "c3d", "..."]] }`, never echoing existing code.
- **Self-Serving Diffs**: Every applied edit returns fresh anchors in the post-edit diff — zero re-read roundtrips to chain edits.
- **Zero-Token Auto-Rebase**: Non-conflicting exterior shifts resolve locally without agent intervention — 0 tokens, 0 retries.
- **Atomic Multi-Item Batches**: Apply up to 32 same-file edits in one tool call; overlapping spans abort atomically (`[E_BATCH_ABORT]`) before touching disk.

dsh-better-edit README · 2. 🛡️ Resistance to External Writes (Drift & Concurrency)：- **Auto-Formatter Immunity**: Strips ASCII whitespace before hashing. Prettier, Black, and ESLint format-on-save passes never rotate anchors.
- **Exterior Shift Auto-Rebase**: External edits, git checkouts, or background processes outside the edit span rebase seamlessly without agent intervention.
- **Fail-Closed Reject-and-Serve**: Contested interior spans fail closed without disk corruption and immediately return fresh on-disk rows in the error (`[E_STALE_RANGE]`, `[E_UNSERVED_RANGE]`) — recovering in **exactly 1 turn**.
- **Session-Keyed Leases**: Leases are isolated per session, preventing cross-agent race conditions or state pollution.

dsh-better-edit README · 3. 🎯 Zero Silent Miswrites：- **Decoupled Line Identity**: Lines are verified against served snapshot lineage, not ephemeral line coordinates.
- **Collision-Free Anchors**: Coprime bitset probing ensures duplicate lines in a file receive distinct, unambiguous 3-character hashes.
- **No Heuristic Guessing**: Retires fuzzy matching. If an anchor cannot be unambiguously resolved, it fails closed safely.
- **Persisted Undo**: `undo_last_edit` restores exact file content, BOM, line endings, and original anchors, persisting across session restarts.

dsh-better-edit README · 3. 🎯 Zero Silent Miswrites：---

> _"The harness — not the model — is the bottleneck."_ — Can Bölük, [_The Harness Problem_](https://stencil.so/blog/the-harness-problem)
>
> **3 calls vs 6 · -55.8% tokens · 23/23 correctness.** Tested on realistic external-drift refactoring against OMP wrapper. Payload numbers are deterministic — see [Benchmark](#benchmark).

dsh-better-edit README · Install (pick one)：**dsh 0.2.0+ is supported.** Registration uses `agent/created`, path resolution follows the session's live working directory (`workingDirectory`, with the session header as the pre-0.2.1 fallback), and tool-guidance order comes from `systemPrompt.getSectionOrder`. There is no peer range and no runtime version probing: compatibility comes from that stable surface plus optional-service fallbacks, so a composition that omits `workingDirectory` or `agentPresets` keeps working.

dsh-better-edit README · See it work：**Position-free in one line:** `read 1..5` → `insert @0` → `edit 10..12` still verifies `10..12` (`resist` mode). **Multi-session honesty:** `A:10..12+1` shifts `B:20..30→21..31` → `B` passes (drift notice); `B:12..13` overlapping `A` → `E_STALE_RANGE` + fresh rows, one retry.

Batch atomically — one `edit`, up to 32 same-file ranges:

```json
{
  "path": "src/main.ts",
  "edits": [
    ["a1b", "a1b", "new line 1\n"],

One fails → none write (`[E_BATCH_ABORT]`).

dsh-better-edit README · Configuration：Tenancy and prompt guidance declare once, read at `agent/created`, no code change.

**Store** central by default `$DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-better-edit/runtime/<name>-<hash8>/` (`ls`-readable + `.wsPath` sidecar). DBs are disposable caches — `rm -rf runtime/<name>-<hash8>/` is safe, rebuilt on next `read`.

```yaml

dsh-better-edit README · $DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-better-edit/config.yaml：storeDir: central # central | workspace | /abs
autoGitignore: false
undo_ttl_s: 604800 # 7d, -1 forever
storeMaxAgeS: 2592000 # 30d janitor
storeMaxTotalBytes: 524288000 # 500 MB LRU
```

Env overrides yaml (`DSH_BETTER_EDIT_STORE_DIR`, `DSH_BETTER_EDIT_AUTO_GITIGNORE`).

dsh-better-edit README · $DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-better-edit/config.yaml：**Guidance per preset** — `tool:read` / `tool:edit` / `tool:undo_last_edit` are plain markdown per preset at `$DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-better-edit/<preset>/<section>.md`. The default order is the harness's own tool slot (`systemPrompt.getSectionOrder`: `1100` read, `1300` edit, `1310` undo), so a band change upstream moves the sections with it; front-matter pins a custom order. The seeded roster is the shipped presets — `standard`, `ptc`, `minimal`, `cordis`. Delete or empty a file → default re-seeds at next boot; keep a `---` fence to blank on purpose.

dsh-better-edit README · Why Hashline：**Verified against what was served.** Every resolved line checked against `read`/diff/rejection rows. Stale or unseen → `[E_STALE_RANGE]`/`[E_UNSERVED_RANGE]` + fresh `HASH│content`, retry needs no `read`. Session-scoped — sub-agent serves never validate main edits.

dsh-better-edit README · Why Hashline：**Content-addressed.** `canon(line)` strips ASCII whitespace, `xxh32 → 62³=238,328` anchors. Re-inserting identical text keeps its hash; `prettier`/`eslint --fix` between edits doesn't invalidate. Unique by bitset probing — `}`/`import` repeats never collide; cap `238,328` lines (`[E_LARGE_FILE]`).

**No loop, no ritual.** No-op → `No changes made`; same no-op ×3 → `[E_NOOP_LOOP]`. Diff/echo/rejection rows count as serves — `read` is recovery, not ritual.
dsh-better-edit README · Token economics：Envelope change: hoist `path`, `edits:[[from,to,text]]`, never repeat `old_string`.

| OMP             | **6** | 28,467 |          — | ✅  |

> **Scope & honesty.** Payload deterministic; practical run stochastic. We measure **payload + round-trips**, not throughput. Retries are where the gap is largest — see [edge cases](#comparison).

dsh-better-edit README · Tools：| Tool             | What it does                                                                                                |
| ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `read`           | `HASH│content` with `offset`/`limit`; `[Showing N-M of T]` paging; `>200KB` lines show marker               |
| `read_skill`     | Plain text, no hashes, no serves — editing after it needs a serve                                           |
| `edit`           | `{path, edits:[[from,to,text]]}` `path:string\|null` inference, `""` deletes, atomic ≤32, verify-then-write |
| `undo_last_edit` | `{path}` restores last edit (BOM/line endings/anchors), persisted                                           |
dsh-better-edit README · Tools：`write` stays, but refuses an exact `HASH│` echo for same `session/path/line` before dispatch.

dsh-better-edit README · Error codes：| Code                                                                                   | Meaning                                                                                                    |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `[E_BAD_PAYLOAD]`                                                                      | Bad tuple shape (payload must be `{path, edits}` with 3-position tuples)                                   |
| `[E_STALE_ANCHOR]`                                                                     | No line (hash/retired/canon miss) / multi-line → `read`                                                    |
| `[E_BAD_ANCHOR]`                                                                       | Not bare `3-char`, or `replacement_text` carries `HASH│`/diff-preview prefixes — refused, remove and retry |
| `[E_SERVED_ECHO]`                                                                      | Copied `HASH│` from same session/path/line — refused, remove and retry
dsh-better-edit README · Error codes：Full list in `src/` — every rejection echoes fresh rows, no `read` needed.

| Blind edit         | ✅ reject            | ~                   | ❌            |

dsh-better-edit README · Comparison：`~` partial, `—` n/a. Same lineage — patch library vs dsh tool pair; pick by seam.

**Edge cases:** wrong anchor impossible (verified), disk drift → reject+serve, shift above → nothing moves, repeats → unique/ambiguous, unseen → reject, batch → atomic. See upstream [benchmarks](https://github.com/Rianico/pi-better-edit/blob/main/benchmarks/README.md).

**Battery:** `23/23` tool, `10/10` library (upstream `npm run eval`, same algorithm).

dsh-better-edit README · How Anchors Work：`canon(line)` strips ASCII whitespace → `xxHash32` → `A-Za-z0-9` 3-char (62³). Stable across `prettier`; Unicode/strings stay significant except ASCII whitespace inside strings (linter-only). `stride=62²+62+1` probes bitset → unique; cap `238,328`. Store `hash-store.sqlite` per workspace (central, honoring `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`); 7-day served TTL, janitor `storeMaxAgeS/LRU` + `wal_checkpoint`.

dsh-better-edit README · How It Replaces Built-ins：dsh resolves `agent → preset → global`; built-ins live on preset. Plugin via `cordis.patch.yml`: at `agent/created` registers `read/edit` on agent layer (shadows, auto-unwinds); `write` stays with `pre-execute` guard + `post-execute` auto-read.

| multi-line saved    |   **29–47%**   |     0%      |      **40–53%**      |
